history_summary: Record two native reference correspondences and two complete ambiguity sets for the four MWF001 descriptors.
history_details: Preserve the four distinct MWF001 stocks and source name bridges. The unchanged native resolver provides Microbacterium maritypicum with 22 reference genomes at majority_fraction 1.0, and Ochrobactrum anthropi with 100 reference genomes at majority_fraction 0.94 for the encoded Brucella anthropi descriptor; no exact support numerator is inferred. Agrobacterium tumefaciens and Comamonas testosteroni retain all four and three alternatives respectively. These reference populations do not identify the experimental stock genomes, measure abundance or establish cross-feeding mechanisms. Only two GTDB blocks, four statuses, two complete candidate lists and two native inline events changed. Retain all existing stock notes, primary quotations, biological claims, graph structure and old history. Crosswalk release is unestablished; file mtime is not a release. The source Methods and existing excerpt cache preserve finite coexistence, treatment-specific losses and residual-substrate/model limitations; source recipe, stock-level and causal-extension findings under issues 1574 and 1575 remain open. This scoped technical correction is not a new full scientific review, source-reference validation, generated-product check or aggregate QC.
